entities.summary: 55 Cancri Ac, formally named Brahe, is an extrasolar planet in an eccentric orbit around the Sun-like star 55 Cancri A, making one revolution every 44.34 days. It is the third known planet in order of distance from its star. 55 Cancri Ac was discovered on June 13, 2002, and has a mass roughly half of Saturn.
